method: Real Google OAuth in existing Chrome with the registered test user identified in Google Cloud Audience. No mocked identity provider or token exchange.

tests.name: Google button and OAuth redirect
tests.observed: Continue with Google visible. Real Google account chooser and expected staging Supabase callback.

tests.name: Google consent and PKCE callback
tests.observed: Completed normal name, email and profile consent. Returned through /auth/callback to /account with query cleared and authenticated organization workspace.

tests.name: Session persists on reload
tests.observed: Reload preserved signed-in unassigned state and no assigned listings.

tests.name: Session available in a second tab
tests.observed: Second tab loaded the same authenticated unassigned account.

tests.name: Unassigned private listing denial
tests.observed: Known public HHC listing staff URL returned: The requested organization record is not available to your account. No editor or private record exposed.

tests.name: Unassigned administrator denial
tests.observed: Administration page returned: Administrator access is required. No request or decision queue exposed.

tests.name: Logout and cross-tab invalidation
tests.observed: Signing out in the second tab cleared both account workspaces. First tab reported Your session ended. Sign in again to continue.

tests.name: Logout persists on reload
tests.observed: Reload showed Continue with Google and no authenticated account workspace.

tests.name: Assigned organization permissions
tests.reason: Read-only check of the actual tested Google identity: confirmed active ordinary user, no organization memberships, listing bindings or pending claims. No distinct confirmed reviewer and no active approved listing assignments are available. No permissions were granted for testing.

tests.name: Automatic refresh after real token expiry
tests.reason: The live session did not expire during this run. Existing SDK refresh tests remain synthetic evidence, not a live expiry test.
